title: Extension of P-L4-010 by position on the page: zodiac figure labels standing at the same clock position on different pages agree no more often than shuffled labels, and in ZL they never agree at all
statement: P-L4-010 compares labels at equal positions in the transcription's list. This extension uses where each label stands on the page instead. The ZL transcription records a clock position for 298 figure labels on the twelve zodiac pages. I took every pair of labels on two different pages whose recorded positions lie within 15 degrees of each other, in any ring (4,902 pairs), and counted how many pairs are the same word, and how many are the same or one glyph apart. No rotation is fitted: the hypothesis tested is a roster tied to fixed places round the wheel. Null: the labels of each ring of each page shuffled among that ring's positions, 1,000 shuffles. The design was fixed before the run and run once; the lower-tail figures below were computed afterwards, when the result turned out to lie on the low side. Result, upper tail: ZL3b 0 identical pairs against a null mean of 5.1 (p = 1.0), 44 within one glyph against 47.4 (p = 0.74); IT2a 1 against 4.0 (p = 0.99) and 42 against 43.8 (p = 0.65); RF1b 1 against 4.3 (p = 0.99) and 29 against 37.1 (p = 0.94), IT2a and RF1b labels placed by ZL's positions for the same loci. Power: writing one word at 3 o'clock in the outer ring of every page is detected in 40 of 40 trials in each transliteration. So there is no roster of words tied to places round the wheel, which agrees with P-L4-010 and P-L4-007 by a route that does not depend on list order or starting figure. The low side: identical labels at matching positions are fewer than chance, 0 where about 5 are expected (lower-tail p = 0.005 in ZL3b, 0.08 in IT2a, 0.05 in RF1b, 3,000 shuffles). This was not predicted and I do not claim it; it would mean that when a word is used again on another page it tends to stand elsewhere on the wheel. Limits: positions are ZL's half-hour clock readings, not measurements; the 15 degree window was my choice and I tried no other; pages with 15 labels and pages with 30 are pooled.
check: Recompute from the pinned ZL3b file: labels of unit Lz on the twelve zodiac pages that carry a clock comment, word breaks removed; cross-page pairs within 15 degrees; within-ring shuffle. A separate seat should test the low-side observation as a registered prediction before it is given any weight, with the window fixed in advance, for example on Takahashi's transliteration placed by the same positions.
